_doc: A TMC2209 stepper driver module on the StepStick footprint (BigTreeTech and FYSETC boards, Rsense = 0.11 ohm), a hobby module whose figures are community until measured. Trinamic's own datasheet could not be read, so its figures are from the module makers' pages, and its thermal limits are left out. In UART mode the current is set in software: this set's Vref figures apply to step and direction use. Board in the x-y plane, the header rows along x.
name: tmc2209

motor_voltage_max.rule: Most motor supply (VM) from the features list; the same page and BigTreeTech also give 28 V

current_bare.rule: Continuous RMS per coil, without a heat sink: FYSETC's figure for the SilentStepStick boards; measure yours

current_cooled.rule: Continuous RMS per coil, the makers' headline rating, with cooling

current_peak.rule: Peak per coil, the makers' headline rating

vref_formula.rule: The RMS coil current set by the voltage on the trimmer, as the module's page gives it from the chip's datasheet. Peak current equals Vref at Rsense 0.11. Use 0.2 to 2.2 V; the board comes set to about 1.2 V (0.9 A RMS)

vref_gain.rule: RMS current per volt of Vref at Rsense 0.11. 1.2 V sets about 0.85 A RMS

microsteps.value: 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 with MS1 and MS2 alone; 1/256 by UART
microsteps.rule: MS1 and MS2 pick 1/2 (GND, VIO), 1/4 (VIO, GND), 1/8 (GND, GND), 1/16 (VIO, VIO), and the chip interpolates each step to 1/256

max_microsteps.rule: The finest division of a full step, set by UART

uart_note.value: UART on PDN_UART (J1 pin 4) as BigTreeTech ships it
uart_note.rule: To use pin 5 instead, move the board's resistor to the other pads. Check which pin your own board uses

pin_pitch.rule: Pin spacing along a header row (0.1 in), as the StepStick footprint

row_spacing.rule: Between the two header rows, as the StepStick footprint

pin_count.rule: Pins in all, eight to a row

body_width.rule: Board length along the header rows; measure yours

body_depth.rule: Board width across the rows; measure yours

pinout.value: EN MS1 MS2 PDN_UART (two more, by maker) STEP DIR | VM GND A2 A1 B1 B2 VIO GND
pinout.rule: The two rows, each from one end to the other. Pins 1 to 4, 7 and 8 of J1 are as the StepStick; pins 5 and 6 differ between makers (CLK, a moved PDN/TX), so read your board's silkscreen
